title: Forgetting the native Weil exceptional adjoint
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$ and let $g_T$ be geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the small pro-etale site of $T$, let $R_T$ be the coefficient sheaf whose sections on a quasi-compact object $V$ are continuous functions $|V|\to\Omega$ with values in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$; on general objects impose this condition locally [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ for its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal B_T$ for pairs $(F,\theta:g_T^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F)$ in $\mathcal A_T$, with intertwining morphisms [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Derived categories mean localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal W(T_0)\subset D(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full subcategory with bounded cohomology whose underlying cohomology sheaves admit a finite locally closed stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions over $R_T$. This is the native category `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex`, not the category of fixed pairs in $D(\mathcal A_T)$.

Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-morphism between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes and let $f:X\to Y$ be its geometric fiber. Use the exact forgetful functors $U_T$ induced termwise by $\mathcal B_T\to\mathcal A_T$, restricted to the native bounded constructible subcategories, and the coefficient realizations $\rho_T$ of [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization]. Let $F_f^{\mathrm W}:\mathcal W(X_0)\to\mathcal W(Y_0)$ be the native derived compact-support functor `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek`, formed from equivariant open extension by zero and proper direct image along a compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Suppose $F_f^{\mathrm W}$ has a right adjoint $G_f^{\mathrm W}$ on these native constructible categories. Let $F_f=Rf_!$ and $G_f=Rf^!$ be the common-stage constructible functors of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

There are natural isomorphisms of functors into the ordinary module derived categories
$$U_YF_f^{\mathrm W}\cong\rho_YF_f\rho_X^{-1}U_X,\qquad U_XG_f^{\mathrm W}\cong\rho_XG_f\rho_Y^{-1}U_Y.$$
They identify the adjunction units and counits, using the scalar-unit-normalized coefficient realizations. At the point $s_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$, forgetting the native constant Weil sheaf gives the ordinary module coefficient unit $R_s[0]\cong\rho_s(\Omega)$. In particular for $f_0=a_{X_0}:X_0\to s_0$ they identify $U_X(G_{a_{X_0}}^{\mathrm W}\Omega^{\mathrm W})$ with $\rho_X(Ra_X^!\Omega)$, where $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. This asserts compatibility for the actual derived category of equivariant sheaves, including its extension morphisms; it asserts no equivalence between that category and Frobenius pairs in the ordinary derived category.

source.place: Exceptional-adjunction assertion and equivariant units and counits; Q10 native derived comparison obligation for lean/WeilConjectures/WeilSheaf/VerdierDual.lean lines 62-113 and LowerShriek.lean (the comparison is not obtained by identifying derived Weil sheaves with fixed pairs).

proof.text: Choose simultaneous forgetful models and the normalized left comparisons with representing counit triples.

Apply forgetful_representingPair_rightMate to these triples and each assumed native adjunction. The resulting asIso is the right comparison. Its unit equation is the theorem's unit equation; cancel the left-comparison hom in its counit equation to obtain Comparison.counit.

Obtain the ordinary native point unit. Compose it with ForgetModel.realization and the specified unitRealization. Full faithfulness of rho lifts this composite to commonUnit; map_preimage is exactly unit_normalization. Evaluate the same right comparison at the constant and apply G to commonUnit. Applying rho gives specialization; its equality is the definition of this composite.

Choose an ordinary coefficient system and compactification of the geometric model structure map. Compose specialization with ordinary structural exceptional unit transport to obtain actualSpecialization at literal Spec(k).
